content.title: UK's Argo Blockchain names former exec as CEO
content.summary: Britain's Argo Blockchain on Monday said former chief growth officer Justin Nolan would return as the cryptocurrency miner's chief executive officer. Nolan, who was most recently the top boss at digital infrastructure firm Arkon Energy, will replace Thomas Chippas, whose departure was announced in January. Argo has faced challenging business conditions since being founded in 2017, and had to sell its Helios mining facility in Texas in 2022 to stave off bankruptcy.
